metricDefinitions.econDeaths: _deadTot: population-pressure loop plus food-debt deaths; historical t17.famineDead
metricDefinitions.starvingVillageDays: sum of live village-days with foodDebtOf(v).starving > 0, sampled after each daily tick
metricDefinitions.starvingPersonDays: sum foodDebtOf(v).starving after each daily tick
metricDefinitions.foodPurchasedEquivalent: executed purchases at market, all canonical food equivalents; return cargo may still be travelling
metricDefinitions.exports: executed market trade-row transfers, post outbound loss; both directions, not all departure manifests

correction: Legacy _deadTot was mislabeled as food-debt famine deaths. It is total econ deaths (logistic population pressure plus debt deaths). True food-debt deaths are _fdDeadTot; hunger uses foodDebtOf(v).starving. Historical invalid starvingDays read nonexistent _fdDay; never use that zero. Legacy raw retained unchanged. All corrected 800-day outputs are byte-identical to original outputs.
outboundKgDefinition: departure kg over accepted outbound market arrivals; OFF uses a separately controlled state transition, including pending T707 settlement; basket uses arrive event; historical all-launch mean is separate

metric.definition: legacy outbound->inbound, not abandoned, original cargo kg before the accepted settlement; includes launches within the sampled daily tick and preserves rerouting state. Comparable to basket arrive c.kg, not the old all-launch T1152 mean.

runs.arrivalPhaseClarification: accepted arrival including T707 pending settlement; marketRows counts completed settlement rows and need not equal arrivals
runs.priorCanonicalKgDefinition: all launched legs, historical reference only; not the arrival sample
